description: Defines the AclNotAllowedException class, a specific runtime exception indicating disallowed access control list-related actions in the Eclipse Ditto model. It includes methods for creating instances from messages and JSON objects, and maintains compatibility with specific schema versions.

classes.name: AclNotAllowedException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException that represents an exception when an access control list is not permitted for a given Thing, including builder and factory methods.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A static inner class providing a mutable builder to construct instances of AclNotAllowedException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Builder instance for constructing an AclNotAllowedException, given a ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AclNotAllowedException from a message string and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AclNotAllowedException from a JSON object and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns an array of supported JSON schema versions, specifically version 1.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new AclNotAllowedException with the specified DittoHeaders, preserving other properties.
